meta.notes: Self-expanding query pool used by the weekly audit routine. Seeds are hand-curated from Meridian's services + suburbs. The routine re-checks each query against live search results every Saturday, harvests up to 5 new queries per run from Google autocomplete on the seeds that matter, and demotes queries that stop yielding useful signal. See docs/audit-dashboard-setup.md §6 for full routine prompt and self-expansion rules. 2026-07-03: autocomplete fetch (suggestqueries.google.com) STILL blocked by routine host egress allowlist — confirmed again via curl ('Host not in allowlist'). Workaround retained: pool self-expands via queries derived from previous-run SERP gaps + new site content (source: 'derived'). Durable fix = widen the routine egress allowlist. This run added 5 derived queries: 'acupuncture for menopause christchurch' (extends Min Jin's women's-health lens beyond endometriosis/PCOS/dysmenorrhoea), 'post concussion recovery christchurch' + 'concussion clinic christchurch' (split intent from post-concussion syndrome — the syndrome SERP is dominated by ACC concussion-service contract holders, not treatment providers, so we need finer-grained coverage before item #32 ships a /conditions/concussion/ page), 'tennis elbow christchurch' (tests whether the new #3 win for 'tennis elbow osteopath christchurch' extends beyond the 'osteopath' modifier), 'shin splints osteopath christchurch' (sports-injury sub-condition — sits under our /conditions/sports-injury-recovery/ page structure that's now surfacing). Three queries pruned this run (below priority 20 for three consecutive runs): 'headaches migraines osteopath christchurch' (superseded by 'headaches osteopath christchurch' added last run), 'paediatric osteopath christchurch' (hollow SERP for us; the entity-linkage win noted last run was via happyspine.co.nz/nina-hu, not a Meridian URL), 'acupuncture vs dry needling' (informational US-dominated query, chronically at 5). NOTABLE WINS 2026-07-03: (1) 'tennis elbow osteopath christchurch' — meridianosteopathy.co.nz/conditions/sports-injury-recovery/ appeared at rank #3 (previously not visible). Priority raised 15 → 20. (2) 'sports injury osteopath christchurch' — same /conditions/sports-injury-recovery/ URL appeared at rank #10 (previously not visible at 7 weeks post-ship). Both wins likely traceable to the structured 5-7 item list block PR #97 (item #34) shipped 2026-06-03, which added a lists array to conditions.json — sports-injury-recovery's lists include lateral epicondylitis / tennis elbow as a treated condition. First direct evidence that the list-block content is producing SERP visibility. NOTABLE NEW COMPETITOR 2026-07-03: performanceplusphysiochch.co.nz now has a dedicated /osteopath-addington-christchurch/ URL — first NZ site to attempt suburb-page ownership of 'osteopath addington' (previously UK-only hollow SERP). Item #29 (Addington in flowing intro copy, shipped 2026-05-10) 8+ weeks post-ship without matching effect; single-page competitors continue to be the pattern that wins hollow-suburb SERPs. NOTABLE INTENT SIGNAL 2026-07-03: 'post concussion syndrome christchurch' SERP is dominated by ACC concussion-service contract holders (Laura Fergusson, Concussion Care NZ, Habit Health, Axis Sports Medicine, TBI Health, APM) — NOT osteopaths. This suggests the 'syndrome' phrasing pulls diagnostic/rehab intent rather than treatment-provider intent. Item #32 (add /conditions/concussion/) should target 'concussion osteopath christchurch' and 'post concussion osteopath christchurch' (both osteo-populated SERPs); the pure-syndrome variant may be an over-target.
